purpose: Test whether a genuinely new candidate-independent causal route-relative approach/intrusion measurement adds separability beyond track/relation/timing, without training, candidate execution, policy tuning, or opener integration.
hypothesis: A track is more discriminative when at least two of route-relative radial distance, route-relative lateral distance, and normalized bbox scale move toward the route-risk direction over the same causal five-frame history.
non_goals: train or fit a model, sweep a threshold, select a history window, or choose a component combination after signal output is visible
modify detector, T0, causal route, active relation, reset, C1-C3, truth, oracle, clearance, two-frame guard, TTL, renewal, or opener
interpret image-plane trend as physical TTC, calibrated distance, collision probability, user outcome, or safety authority
retain the signal if it fails simultaneous complete coverage and empirical negative-exposure risk
create more policy contracts or timing variants to rescue a rejected new-information signal

signal.name: causal_route_relative_intrusion_trend_2_of_3
signal.camera_motion_scope: route-relative image-plane position subtracts the contemporaneous causal route-UV displacement and therefore compensates common image translation only; rotation, scale, depth, and full ego-motion compensation are not claimed
signal.slope_estimator: median of all 10 past-only pairwise slopes over exactly five consecutive valid frames
signal.positive_rule: radial slope < 0 plus lateral slope < 0 plus log-height slope > 0; at least two of three
signal.optimistic_validity: activation remains eligible only through the same uninterrupted route-known active-relation episode; no nominal TTL is applied in this separability probe

phase_order: verify frozen config and all parent hashes before signal output
rebuild 123 candidate projections and prove frame-exact equality before collapse
producer computes and freezes all signal ledgers with zero truth event oracle or negative-exposure decode
separate audit process reverifies every ledger SHA
only then join 12 candidate-independent events and full half-open negative exposure
quantify coverage risk and delta versus the current-family bound
retain only on simultaneous 11/11 coverage and at most two empirical negative activations; otherwise reject
